item.title: Ella Langley Tulsa concert canceled after security threat report
item.description: Ella Langley's Friday concert in Tulsa, Oklahoma, was canceled following what was described as a serious security threat.

item.title: Trump says determination being made on Hasan execution livestream
item.description: Trump said he supports the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan, but it is unclear whether he backs Hegseth's livestream plan.

item.title: Fort Hood survivors react to livestream of Hasan execution
item.description: Alonzo Lunsford, shot multiple times, said he plans to attend in person and wants to lock eyes with shooter Nidal Hasan.

item.title: Video shows Virginia police rescuing man from house fire
item.description: Police in Culpeper, Virginia, carried out a daring rescue of an unconscious but breathing man during a house fire.
